CustomField.description: Shortened project name (PPPPP segment). Auto-filled from ProjectName__c with every non-alphanumeric character removed, uppercased, first 5 characters (e.g. "ST. Lukes United" -> "STLUK") when blank; a manually entered value is preserved but normalised the same way.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Short code for the project name (PPPPP segment). Defaults to the first 5 letters/digits of the Project Name; you may override it - punctuation is always stripped.
CustomField.label: Short Project Name
